Nora (CS): Brightloop onboarding hit a snag. Their Java SDK init calls intermittently 401 with our service saying 'kid_mismatch'. They flagged renewal anxiety if we don't resolve today.
Leo (AE): Are they using our sample JWK or bringing their own key? Can you get the raw kid?
Nora (CS): They're using a company HSM. Sent a redacted kid in DM. Their engineer says the kid ends with one or two '=' characters. Example they pasted: `c2lnbmluZ19rZXk9`
Jin (SSRE): '=' is padding from standard base64. Our kid indexer stores keys normalized as base64url without padding. If their HSM exported standard base64 (with +/ and '='), lookup would fail.
Nora (CS): Customer says local verification against our published JWK works, but requests still 401 from our endpoint. Logs show lookup key not found.
Jin (SSRE): Quick test suggestion for them: decode the kid and show bytes. Ask them to run: `echo c2lnbmluZ19rZXk9 | base64 -d | xxd -p` and paste output. That'll confirm encoding/padding.
Nora (CS): They ran it and confirmed padding present. Also said some SDK versions strip trailing '=' so results vary by service instance.
Jin (SSRE): Two mitigation paths: 1) quick server-side normalization that strips '=' padding and accepts both base64 and base64url; 2) ask customer to re-export URL-safe kid without padding. I can implement (1) as a hotfix: ~20m code + tests, 40m to canary, then prod.
Leo (AE): I'll flag renewal_monitoring on the account and schedule a status check-in at 11am PT. Customer prefers we push fix vs re-exporting.
Nora (CS): Customer just confirmed they can re-export if we can't push within 3h, but prefer we do the server fix to avoid future customers hitting same.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for commit def456  auth-kid-normalize-strip-padding by Jin. Staging: https://staging.redwood/ci/def456
Jin (SSRE): Canary logs show normalized hits: added metric auth.kid.normalized=1 for incoming requests that required padding strip. No errors in staging. Rolling to prod now.
Nora (CS): Brightloop confirmed successful init after prod deploy; onboarding flows resumed. They've asked for a short post-mortem and an onboarding checklist update.
Leo (AE): Action items: 1) add 'verify kid encoding/padding' to onboarding checklist; 2) update quickstart snippet to show both export commands for URL-safe output; 3) follow up in 48h to confirm stability and remove renewal_monitoring if good.
Nora (CS): Will file a short notes doc and ping enablement to update docs. Closing thread unless anything else emerges. Thanks team :raised_hands:
